en: As I suspected...everyone was brought here.

Don't act all depressed just cuz you didn't
get to spend any alone time with me!
...Do I look "depressed" to you?

There's no way we wouldn't show up when
we were told there's a chance to escape.
But I still think it smells fishy.

Really? Doesn't it smell like something fun
is gonna happen instead?

You always seem to show up for stuff like this.
I've got you figured out...

Thanks! The key to a mutual friendship
is understanding each other!

...So, what's this "way" for getting out
of here?
Is there really a way?

Duh-doy! Of course there is!
Geniuses like me never make mistakes!
So...how are we going to escape?

We're goin' to <CLT=cltSTRONG>another world<CLT=cltNORMAL>! A world with
no killing games and no Monokuma!
"Another world"?
Oh...you wanna know? Huh? Do ya?

I'll tell ya if you bow to me!
On your knees! Now!
Huh? Why...?

Hehe... When Shuichi and Kaede bowed
to me...it sorta awoke somethin' in me...

Now hurry the fuck up and bow to me, you
masochistic shits!

...Hm? Shouldn't you be the one bowing
down to us?
Huh!?

You want us to listen, right? Then get down
on your knees and beg like a dog.
Wh-What the hell? Isn't that...weird?

Everyone's wasting their precious time on
a worthless piece of trash like you.

So you better bow down and beg.
C'mon, hurry it up.

What? Wh-Why? I stayed up all night getting
this ready for everyone—
Okie then! Everyone, let's gooooo!
W-W-Wait!!!
I wanna...talk about it...
...I actually feel sorry for her.
Hey...let's at least hear her out.
Did ya hear that, Miu? Good for you!

How long are you gonna be depressed for,
you sow!? Hurry up and tell us, squid-breath!
Heeeee! Y-Yes, sir!

U-Ummmm... So when I said "another world,"
I was talkin about this big-ass computer...
What? This?

Th-There's this device connected to the
computer that you put on your head...

It uploads your consciousness so you can go
to a world created by a computer program.
A world created by a computer program?
Oh...Gonta understand!

Exit is in that <CLT=cltSTRONG>kon-poo-ter<CLT=cltNORMAL> box! So we gotta
break it open and go in!?

N-No! If you try to force your way in, you'll
just destroy it!
You mean this virtual reality, right?

I-It's more than just virtual reality...
It's...a Virtual World...

Because...your consciousness will be able to
move around as if you're in the real world.

Ah! It's the matrix! I saw a movie about that
sort of thing on TV when I was little!
Alright, now let's go!
Huh? Go? Like, to the Virtual World?
Yeah! Let's all go together!
No way!

What!? Why!? You promised that we'd all
come at the same time!

I didn't promise you anything!
What are you talking about!?
Just in case, I should ask a question...

What's going to happen to our <CLT=cltSTRONG>consciousness<CLT=cltNORMAL>
when we're inside the computer?

Oh, so we use <CLT=cltSTRONG>avatars<CLT=cltNORMAL> as our new bodies to
link our <CLT=cltSTRONG>consciousness<CLT=cltNORMAL> to the Virtual World.
...How do you know this?
Miu told me already.

I helped her prepare our trip to the Virtual
World! I brought all of our seats here...
In exchange, I made her tell me the reason.
So that's what the apology was.

Um... What you guys talking about?
What's this..."<CLT=cltSTRONG>ah-vuh-tar<CLT=cltNORMAL>"?

They're characters that will represent you
while you're in the Virtual World.

In other words, this computer will transfer
our <CLT=cltSTRONG>consciousness<CLT=cltNORMAL> from our bodies...

...and shove 'em into <CLT=cltSTRONG>avatars<CLT=cltNORMAL> inside the
Virtual World. And then...

we'll have new bodies in a new world!
A world without murder and Monokuma!
But what happens to our real bodies?

Your body will basically be asleep for the
duration. In that sense, it'll be like a dream.
Alright, let's go!

Like I said, we're not going.
It's definitely dangerous.

Shut the fuck up, donkey-lips! I'm tellin' you,
it's not fuckin' dangerous!

Saying that makes it sound even more
dangerous!
Heeeeeeeeeeee!

Wh-What the—?
Am I...really that untrustworthy?

Well then, you'll be relieved to know that I
didn't even create this Virtual World...
Someone else made it, apparently.
<CLT=cltMIND>What? Someone else?

Can you really just separate your 
consciousness from your body like that?
We're not just objects, y'know?

Gonta not really understand... We all gonna
sleep and have same dream? That possible?

I'm totally down to go to the Virtual World.
It seems interesting.

This must be remarkable technology if it can
upload our consciousness into a computer...

Do you even have a <CLT=cltSTRONG>consciousness<CLT=cltNORMAL> to send off
to the Virtual World, Kee-boy? You're a robot.

Your tin head can only mimic a human's
emotions through a mechanized process.
Gh...

...I have <CLT=cltSTRONG>consciousness<CLT=cltNORMAL>, too.
At least, I believe I do.

So an avatar is another body...
But I like this one.

This body made my soul,
and my soul made this body...

Which means my body and soul together make
me who I am! Separating them is outrageous!

So it separates the consciousness from the
body... If that's possible, then...
No...it's nothing.

I thought something was different about this
room. It has all these chairs in here now.

They probably brought them in since 
it'll be like our bodies are sleeping.
That was uncharacteristically thoughtful of Miu.

<CLT=cltMIND>I have an idea, but...I should ask
Miu about who made the virtual world.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.

<CLT=cltMIND>The world in there...
No killing game? No Monokuma?
Treasure Chest
Head-mounted Display

Hey, Miu...
Who made the Virtual World?
That's right! It was me!
Nyeeeh! I knew it!
Oh, Daddy! You really can do anything!
Huh? Daddy? Which one...is my daddy?
Him! He's my daddy!
No I'm not!
Now then, allow me to explain!

I used a <CLT=cltSTRONG>certain program<CLT=cltNORMAL> as a template to
create the Virtual World...

And that program is...the <CLT=cltSTRONG>killing game
simulator<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
...Killing game simulator?

Well, with that, I've made up my mind.
I definitely won't go in there now.
W-W-Wait! I said wait, dammit!
If Monokuma made it, it's dangerous for sure.

I pulled an all-nighter investigating it, and
I deleted everything dangerous from it...
It's definitely safe! I swear!

There's no need to worry.
It's just a <CLT=cltSTRONG>simulator<CLT=cltNORMAL>, right?

No, this is Monokuma we're talking about.
It may not even be a real simulator.
Daddy's right!
Hey, whose side are you on?
I'm not your daddy!

How cruel... Why not accept him
as your child for now?

For now? I can't play along.
He's not even my child.

You guys are only bitchin' cuz you haven't
been to the Virtual World yet...
But once you go, you'll understand...

Seriously, it's so fuckin' awesome!
I know you guys will love it!

And then...you're gonna fall in love with me
for showing it to you guys!

So...let's just dive right in, okay?
We'll do it together.

But...it's a world that *Monokuma*
created, right?

If you don't wanna dive in, you can just
dip the tip!
The tip of what!?

But you just said you pulled an all-nighter
adjusting everything, right, Miu?

So that means...it was originally a killing game
simulator, but not anymore, yeah?
Y-Yeah, that's right...

I rewrote the program to delete all dangerous
objects that could be used as weapons.
That's what a good mommy would do!
M-Mommy!?

Wh-What's this weird sensation in my chest?
I-Is this...what it feels like to be a mom?

Hey, let's trust Miu! We should trust in our
friends more anyway!
Why...are you on Miu's side?

I'm not taking her side, but it's like...I have
a feeling we'll find something in that world.
...Something?

I mean, Monokuma created this world, right?
Maybe he laid a bait to lure us in!

Like...a super duper crazy secret hidden
in that world!
A secret?

Well, Monokuma? Did you prepare some
sort of bait for us?
Oh, bait? Yeah, of course I have.

Huh, really? This is the first I've heard
of this.
Me too!
...Mommy's hearing this for the first time, too.
She accepted him!?

Like Kokichi said, there's a crazy secret
hidden somewhere in the Virtual World.
...It's <CLT=cltSTRONG>the secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
The secret...of the outside world?

All I can tell you about the secret is that
if you get your hands on it...

You'll instantly learn what's happening
outside of the academy!

H-Hold on... What's happening outside?
What are you talking about?

It's like he's saying something is going on 
out there, but...that can't be, right?

Do you think it has to do with those
meteorites?

Puhuhu, is your curiosity piqued?
Then you have no choice but to go.
Yeah! We wanna know, so we'll definitely go!

Kokichi...what's going on here?
Did you know about this all along?

That Monokuma is hiding a secret
in the virtual world?

Don't joke around like that...
It's just a hunch.

Anyway, we can't ignore it. It's possible
we might find info on the outside world.

Maybe with that info, we could even put
an end to this killing game.
Huh!? We can end killing game!?

Then Gonta will go! Gonta will go to this...
"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ver-chew-ul World<CLT=cltNORMAL>" place!

Wait...you can't! It's probably a trap 
set by Monokuma!

But if there's even a small chance that we
can stop the killing game, we should take it.
...Yes, that's what my inner voice is telling me.

Are you still talking about your inner voice?
We're already sick of all that Atua stuff.

As I've mentioned before, this has nothing
to do with Angie's influence.

Whenever I'm lost, my inner voice tells me
what to do.

I have always obeyed that voice, and I will
continue to do so.

That's why I'm going to go to the Virtual
World!
Then I'm going too.
You too, Kaito?

Yeah, this "<CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>" stuff
worries me, but I want to check this world out.
Call it a man's curiosity!!!
The idiot's at it again...

Wh-When a man loses his curiosity, he ages!
Curiosity is what moves a man!

You can stop talking now, but...I guess I'll be
an idiot, too.

Ah, wait...
You're going too, Maki?

Of course. You're coming along, right, Shuichi?
And don't say no because it's dangerous.
We've been in danger for a while now.
<CLT=cltMIND>That's true...

<CLT=cltMIND>My ability...is to gather evidence
and reveal the truth.
<CLT=cltMIND>So I can't run away from this.
Alright...I'll go too.

B-But why!? It's definitely going 
to be dangerous!

No matter how dangerous it gets, we just
have to do it.

Fine...I'll go too.
Being left behind will just make me worry.
Then everyone, except Tsumugi, is going!
W-Wait... If everyone is gonna go...I will too.
Nee-heehee...okay, now everyone's going.
Kokichi...are you planning something?

Ah-haha, of course not. After Kaito punched
me, I became a changed man.
So...relax and just trust me.

Alright! Then let's get started before you
cockroaches change your damn minds!

First, each of you gotta grab a helmet
and plant your ass in one of those seats!
Okay, fine...

<CLT=cltMIND>With Miu instructing us, we got in
position around the computer.

You see those two ports on the back of
the visor?
You mean this?

That's where you plug in the two cords
that connect you to the computer!
Ah, these cords.

The red cord is for <CLT=cltSTRONG>consciousness<CLT=cltNORMAL>, and the
blue cord is for <CLT=cltSTRONG>memory<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

I could start throwin' down some real fancy
techno-jargon, but you idiots wouldn't get it...

All you need to know is those cords'll cram your
<CLT=cltSTRONG>consciousness<CLT=cltNORMAL> and <CLT=cltSTRONG>memory<CLT=cltNORMAL> into the Virtual World.

Just don't shove 'em into the wrong hole!
And yes, that *is* what she said!
Okay, fine...if she said so.
So then, which cords to which ports?

Put the red <CLT=cltSTRONG>consciousness<CLT=cltNORMAL> cord in the right
port, and the blue <CLT=cltSTRONG>memory<CLT=cltNORMAL> cord in the left.

Out of curiosity...what happens if you
switch the cords?

I dunno. I've never done that before...
Probably gets all glitchy or something!

Maybe you'll become a vegetable, maybe you'll
body-swap with someone... Who knows?

Well...I guess we'll just have to be careful
not to switch the cords, then.

I-It's okay... If we j-j-just stay calm,
then there...won't be any problems.

O-Okay...so I hold my chopsticks
in my r-right hand, so...
Calm down, Himiko...

<CLT=cltMIND>After some fiddling around, we were
all hooked up to the device.

Then you just gotta put the helmet on
your head.

Finally, press the button near your temple and
you'll be whisked away to the Virtual World!

A paradise more beautiful than the real world,
where there's no murder and no Monokuma!

So when Gonta press button,"<CLT=cltSTRONG>ava-tar<CLT=cltNORMAL>" person
take Gonta to "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ver-chew-ul World<CLT=cltNORMAL>" place?

Oh, for the love of... Yeah, sure, whatever
makes sense to you.

By the way, I tweaked your avatars to
make 'em resemble you guys.

In fact, compared to your current looks,
they're a major improvement!

Congrats, Himiko! You don't need to pay
for expensive plastic surgery anymore!

I never wanted plastic surgery...
I like my face.
*sigh* I'm still nervous about this...

Just shut up and fuckin' do it already,
Four-Eyes! Geez!
Alright, everybody! Let's go!

<CLT=cltMIND>We can't ignore a chance to discover
clues about <CLT=cltSTRONG>the outside world<CLT=cltMIND>.
Okay...let's go.
Have a good time!

<CLT=cltMIND>I placed the helmet on my head, and after
a deep breath, turned on the switch.
<CLT=cltMIND>...And then...
